claims.scope: For every Boolean h and every deterministic physical restriction tree querying no coordinate twice on a root-leaf path, sum_v w_v alpha_v^2 ln(1/alpha_v^2) <= (2/e) I(h).
hypotheses: h is a genuine Boolean sign
w_v is the exact uniform cylinder probability
the queried coordinate is fresh on its path
natural logarithms; divide by ln(2) for bits

proof_dependencies.claim: Boolean edge correlation is bounded by physical pivotal probability

proof_dependencies.evidence: proved by the nonreuse condition in ADAPTIVE_LOG_PAYMENT.tex

claims.scope: Exact identity D_i(a+h b)=qD_i(h)+R_mu(alpha), including the mandatory scalar mean correction -qK(mu,alpha), for every genuine Boolean disjoint splice.
For fixed finite outer Fourier arrays and fixed 0<|mu|<1, R_mu(alpha)/(alpha^2 ln(1/alpha^2)) tends to minus the exact collision energy Z_mu; at mu=0 it tends to q-Z_0.
Dimension-free payment of the complete biased coherent remainder over a hierarchy with changing means, near-collision gaps, and coherent activation witnesses.
claims.exact_obstruction: The alpha-log envelope is paid adaptively, but the kernel difference is nonuniform when mu=O(alpha) or a_T+mu b_T=O(alpha b_T), and the outer activation may change with the restricted variables.
